name: Luna Virelith
source:
Codenamed SILENCER, Luna is one of AEGIS's top agents and an expert in in both armed and unarmed combat.
Ever since a childhood incident involving the syndicates left her family destitute, she has dedicated her life to fighting them. As such, she joined the Academy at the youngest age she could, where she met her soon-to-be husband, Aiden.
With his support, she graduated with distinction and began her life as the top crime-fighter in Neo Elysia.
